items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: we had done some things at Town Hall, at Carnegie Hall

ctx.x: He said, I'll just take me a nice slow boat and go to Europe. So I'm thinking about this and a couple of days later I'm talking to him again about it and said, Joe, you know one thing. You can't go by boat. He said, Why can't I go by boat. I said, Because the whole ocean is mined. They're liable to blow you up. He looked at me very seriously and he said, Coca-Cola people I'm out.

What happened, Eddie Condor, we had done some things at Town Hall, at Carnegie Hall, you know ... with the Coca-Cola people. And, what the hell, I needed the money. It sounds good. We had a good group of musicians there. I think it's going to be nice and quiet. She disrupted my idea altogether. ... that was over.
Think you went from there to the Vanguard. Didn't you? That's where you took a small group to the Vanguard.
